briefdescription.para: FWB-01: overhead of computing p95 latency from a 20-sample rolling window and updating the adaptive interval.

detaileddescription.para: Uses a standalone p95-sort simulation that mirrors updateAdaptiveInterval() logic without requiring a full AutoFailoverManager instance.

briefdescription.para: FWB-02: overhead of quorum entry CRC32 computation and string serialization.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates the work performed by QuorumLog::append() excluding the actual file write (which would be I/O-bound and not representative of the hot path overhead).

briefdescription.para: FWB-03: overhead of TopologySnapshot::capture() with 16 nodes.

detaileddescription.para: Capture includes copying the failure map and sorting node IDs for deterministic ordering.

briefdescription.para: FWB-04: overhead of has_topology_change() + added_nodes() between two 16-node snapshots that differ by one node.
FWB-05: overhead of scanning and pruning a 20-element failure-timestamp vector to determine whether GC grace period applies.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates the inner loop of checkAndApplyGcGrace().

briefdescription.para: FWB-06: overhead of quorum deadline check when quorum is instantly satisfied.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates the tight loop in checkAndWaitForQuorum() with a no-op hasQuorum mock.

briefdescription.para: FWB-07: overhead of batch stats flush in attemptRecovery() success path.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates the single stats_mutex_ acquisition + three counter increments that replace the per-iteration locking pattern.

briefdescription.para: FWB-08: per-enqueue throughput of triggerManualFailover() queue path under 4 concurrent producers.

detaileddescription.para: Simulates the mutex-protected queue push without the full manager overhead.

Provides reproducible latency measurements for the new failover hot paths introduced in Wave B: adaptive health-check scheduling, quorum log append, topology snapshot capture, and concurrent recovery lifecycle paths.
